description: This file defines the 'History' class within the AWS SDK for PHP. The class manages a container that tracks command executions, requests, and results for AWS service interactions, including features to start and finish entries, retrieve the most recent command/request/result, and handle the history entries in a bounded array.

classes.name: History
classes.description: Container class that records command, request, result, and exception history during AWS SDK command executions. Supports adding entries, retrieving last entries, counting, iterating, and clearing history.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the history container with an optional maximum size for entries.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of entries currently stored in the history.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the stored history entries.

methods.name: getLastCommand
methods.description: Retrieves the last command executed, throws exception if none exist.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the last request made, throws exception if none exist.

methods.name: getLastReturn
methods.description: Retrieves the last return value or exception; throws exception if no entries.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins tracking a new command and request, returning a unique ticket identifier.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks a history entry as finished with a result or exception, enforces maximum size.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all history entries as an array.
